headword: {学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}

definitions.explanation: Life as a student, including studies, friendships, club activities, and school events. Typically refers to the overall experience at a high school or college, especially in the context of fiction or nostalgia.

examples.japanese: {学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}を{楽|たの}しむ。
この{漫画|まんが}は{高校生|こうこうせい}の{学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}を{描|えが}いている。
examples.english: This manga depicts the school life of high school students.

examples.japanese: {部活動|ぶかつどう}や{文化祭|ぶんかさい}など、{充実|じゅうじつ}した{学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}を{送|おく}った。
examples.english: I had a fulfilling school life with club activities, the culture festival, and more.

notes:
Compound of {学園|がくえん} (academy, school) and {生活|せいかつ} (life, daily living). Carries a softer, more nostalgic feel than the neutral {学校|がっこう}{生活|せいかつ}, and is especially common as a genre label in manga, anime, and light novels ({学園|がくえん}もの).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}を{送|おく}る: to live a school life; to have (a particular kind of) school life
- {楽|たの}しい{学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}: enjoyable school life
- {充実|じゅうじつ}した{学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}: fulfilling school life
- {学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}の{思|おも}い{出|で}: memories of school life

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学校|がっこう}{生活|せいかつ}: school life — neutral and more commonly used in everyday speech, often about elementary or junior high school
- キャンパスライフ: campus life — loanword focused on university life
- {青春|せいしゅん}: youth; the springtime of life — the emotional / nostalgic associations often implied by {学園生活|がくえんせいかつ}
